title: Bunnie Xo Reveals Her DMs Are Full of Thirsty Men Amid Jelly Roll Divorce: ‘Send Help’
contentText:
Bunnie Xo ‘s DMs are apparently like the Wild West right now, with the influencer posting a video poking fun at all the thirsty men who’ve been hitting her up since her divorce from Jelly Roll went public.

In the Tuesday (June 23) clip, Bunnie wears different face-morphing filters to make herself look like various men — with a diverse range of facial hair — while singing along to Petey Pablo’s highly explicit song “Freek-A-Leek,” on which he offers a list of NSFW suggestions for things to do in the bedroom. “What it’s like opening my DMs right now,” she wrote in text over the video.

Related

A Timeline of Jelly Roll & Bunnie Xo’s Relationship

Bunnie Xo Tells Her Side of Jelly Roll Divorce & Says They’re Still Having a Baby: ‘We Are Having Our Little Nugget Together’

Jelly Roll’s Daughter Bailee Says She’s ‘Disgusted’ by Public Interest in His Divorce From Bunnie Xo

“Send help,” the Dumb Blonde host added in the caption.

The tongue-in-cheek post comes a little over a week after TMZ uncovered court documents revealing that Jelly had filed to divorce Bunnie after nearly a decade of marriage in May. The memoir author has since shared her side of the story in a podcast episode posted a few days after the news broke, explaining that — even though she felt blindsided by the country star’s filing — she and her ex are still “best friends” and will still welcome a baby together via IVF despite their split.

She also revealed that Jelly has started looking for love again since the breakup. “My husband is ready to date,” Bunnie said on the pod, laughing. “He’s rearing and ready to go … he’s even started dating, which is great, I love that.”
